name: VideoButton

component.name: VideoButton
component.description: Starts or stops the local camera and provides a camera-selection menu. The controls are disabled while disconnected.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the control root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the control root.

props.name: isMobile
props.description: Displays the camera menu as a mobile bottom sheet. Not detected automatically.

props.name: showMenu
props.description: Shows the camera menu while connected when camera controls or custom menu groups are available and either the camera is on, or cameras are available and the camera has been turned on at least once since the session connected.

props.name: menuGroups
props.description: Additional menu groups shown after the camera choices. The menu becomes available once the camera has been turned on (see showMenu).

props.name: dropdownOptions
props.description: Menu placement, styling, and container options. Ignored when isMobile is true.

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Custom content for the main button. Object keyed by state ('videoOn', 'videoOff', 'loading', 'warning'); each value is a React node or a function receiving VideoButtonRenderContext. Only the keys you provide are overridden; others use the default icon. See contentStateRules for which state applies.

behavior: The button is disabled until the session is connected, while camera controls are unavailable, and while the camera is starting or stopping.
Clicking starts or stops the camera.
While the camera is starting or stopping, the button's accessible label is 'Working...'.
The menu lists Camera choices, then your menuGroups.
The current camera is checked and can't be chosen again. Camera choices are disabled while a switch is in progress.
The camera list shows 'No devices' when no cameras are found. A camera without a name is listed by its device ID.
When the camera is off, choosing a camera selects it for the next start.
When the menu is hidden, only the main button is shown.
On mobile (isMobile), choosing a menu item closes the sheet.

types.name: VideoButtonRenderContext
types.description: Camera status, device choices, labels, and actions available to custom button content.

fields.name: videoState
fields.description: Current camera status. Until the session is connected, it reports defaults: camera off, not loading, no warning, no background selected, and only the built-in None and Blur backgrounds.

fields.name: deviceState
fields.description: Available devices, selected devices, and device-switching status.

fields.name: canControlVideo
fields.description: Whether camera controls are available in the connected session.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Localized action label: 'Start video' when the camera is off, 'Stop video' when it is on. The main button uses it as its accessible label, except while the camera is starting or stopping ('Working...').

fields.name: menuLabel
fields.description: Localized accessible label for the camera menu ('Video options').

fields.name: isDisabled
fields.description: Whether the main button is disabled (not connected, cannot control video, or isLoading).

fields.name: isMenuTriggerDisabled
fields.description: Whether the camera dropdown trigger is disabled (not connected, or no custom groups and cannot control video).

fields.name: toggleVideo
fields.description: Starts or stops the local camera. Has no effect while disconnected.

fields.name: startVideo
fields.description: Starts the local camera. Has no effect while disconnected.

fields.name: stopVideo
fields.description: Stops the local camera. Has no effect while disconnected.

fields.name: switchCamera
fields.description: Selects the camera by device ID. When the camera is off, it selects the camera for the next start. Has no effect while disconnected.

types.name: VideoState
types.description: Current local camera status, settings, and virtual background readiness.

fields.name: isVideoOn
fields.description: True when the local camera is active for the current user. Updated only while VideoButton, the SettingsPanel Video tab, or a component that calls useVideoController is mounted.

fields.name: vbImageId
fields.description: Selected background ID: '' for none, 'blur', or one of your image IDs. It returns to sessionOptions.video.virtualBackground.defaultVirtualBackgroundImageId when the connection state changes or when you pass a new sessionOptions object, so keep sessionOptions stable (for example with useMemo).

fields.name: virtualBackgroundImageList
fields.description: Available background choices: the built-in None (id '') and Blur (id 'blur') entries, followed by the valid custom images from sessionOptions. The built-in entries' names are English only and their url is not an image, so show your own translated labels and no thumbnail for them.

fields.name: isVirtualBackgroundReady
fields.description: Whether the Video SDK virtual background model is ready. Before offering virtual backgrounds, also check useVideoController().canUseVirtualBackground.

fields.name: isMirrored
fields.description: Whether the local camera preview is mirrored. Defaults to true and resets to true if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: hardwareAccelerationReceiving
fields.description: Whether hardware acceleration is enabled for receiving video (decoding). Starts false and turns true automatically once it can be enabled. useVideoController().setHardwareAcceleration also changes it. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: hardwareAccelerationSending
fields.description: Whether hardware acceleration is enabled for sending video (encoding). Starts false and turns true automatically once it can be enabled. useVideoController().setHardwareAcceleration also changes it. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: isLoading
fields.description: True while video is starting or stopping. For camera switches, use useZoomUIToolkit().deviceState.isSwitchingCamera.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Latest video error, such as a camera, mirroring, or virtual background failure, or null when there is no error.

types.name: DeviceState
types.description: Available media devices, selected devices, and device-switching status.

fields.name: cameras
fields.description: Available cameras. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: microphones
fields.description: Available microphones. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: speakers
fields.description: Available speakers. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: activeCameraId
fields.description: Selected camera ID. Falls back to the default or first available camera. null when no camera is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: activeMicrophoneId
fields.description: Selected microphone ID. Falls back to the default or first available microphone. null when no microphone is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: activeSpeakerId
fields.description: Selected speaker ID. Falls back to the default or first available speaker. null when no speaker is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: isSwitchingCamera
fields.description: Whether a camera change is in progress.

fields.name: isSwitchingMicrophone
fields.description: Whether a microphone change is in progress.

fields.name: isSwitchingSpeaker
fields.description: Whether a speaker change is in progress.

types.name: MediaDevice
types.description: An available microphone, speaker, or camera.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Device name for display.

fields.name: deviceId
fields.description: Device ID to pass when selecting a microphone, speaker, or camera.

types.name: MediaWarning
types.description: An audio or video error, such as denied permission or a failed operation.

fields.name: type
fields.description: 'permission' when microphone or camera access is denied, 'operation' when an action fails. 'unknown' is reserved and not currently produced.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Details about the failure, when available. It may be a Video SDK error code or reason (for example 'INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES') rather than a user-facing sentence, so show your own text based on `type`.

types.name: VirtualBackgroundImage
types.description: A virtual background choice. Use this shape for images you pass in `sessionOptions.video.virtualBackground.virtualBackgroundImageList`. `videoState.virtualBackgroundImageList` also starts with the built-in None (id '', url '') and Blur (id 'blur', url 'blur') choices, whose names are English only.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique image ID. The values '' and 'blur' are reserved for no background and blur. If an ID is reserved or repeated, only the first entry with that ID is kept.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Non-empty accessible label for the image. Supply a translated label for your application. Entries with empty names are ignored.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Non-empty image URL. Entries with empty URLs are ignored.

fields.name: videoOn
fields.description: Content shown while the camera is on.

fields.name: videoOff
fields.description: Content shown while the camera is off.

fields.name: loading
fields.description: Content shown while the camera is starting or stopping.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Content shown while a camera error is present.

types.name: ToolbarMenuActionItem
types.description: A selectable menu action. In a single-selection group, the selected action displays a check mark.

fields.name: selected
fields.description: Marks the selected action in a group with selectionMode: 'single'.

fields.name: onSelect
fields.type: ((item: ToolbarMenuActionItem, group: ToolbarMenuGroup) => void | Promise<void>) | undefined
fields.description: Called when the action is selected, with the item and its group. Handle errors in asynchronous callbacks.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Omit this property for an action item.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique action ID within the group.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Label content rendered inside the menu item.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: When true, the item is rendered with disabled state and is non-interactive.

types.name: ToolbarMenuDropdownOptions
types.description: Styling, placement, and portal container options for desktop dropdown menus. Only the listed options are supported.

fields.name: className
fields.description: Additional CSS class for the dropdown menu.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Inline styles for the dropdown menu.

fields.name: portalContainer
fields.description: Container for the dropdown and its nested submenus. Defaults to document.body.

fields.name: side
fields.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Defaults to 'bottom'. The menu may move to stay visible.

fields.name: sideOffset
fields.description: Distance from the trigger in pixels. Defaults to 10.

fields.name: align
fields.description: Alignment along the trigger. Defaults to 'start'.

fields.name: alignOffset
fields.description: Offset from the chosen alignment in pixels.

types.name: ToolbarMenuGroup
types.description: A section of menu items with an optional heading and empty-state label.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique group ID.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Optional section heading.

fields.name: emptyLabel
fields.description: Text to show when the group has no items. An empty group without this label is hidden.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Items belonging to this group.

fields.name: selectionMode
fields.description: Set to 'single' for a group of mutually exclusive choices. Mark the current action with selected: true.

types.name: ToolbarMenuItem
types.description: A menu action or a nested menu. Any item with an items property is a nested menu, so leave items out of menu actions.

fields.name: (union)
fields.description: An item is a submenu when it has an 'items' property; otherwise it is a leaf action.

types.name: ToolbarMenuSubmenuItem
types.description: A menu item that opens a nested menu.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Nested items rendered inside the submenu. May themselves contain further submenus (recursive).

fields.name: onSelect
fields.description: Omit this property for a submenu.

fields.name: selected
fields.description: Omit this property for a submenu.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique submenu ID within the group.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Submenu label and mobile submenu heading.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: When true, the submenu trigger is rendered with disabled state and the submenu cannot be opened.

contentStateRules.description: Custom-content state and default icon, in priority order. The first matching state is used.

rules.matchedWhen: The camera is starting or stopping.
A camera error is present, including while the camera is on.

notifications.cameraPermission: ZoomUIToolkitProvider shows 'Camera access is required.' with 'Allow access in your browser settings, then try again.' and a Close action when camera access is denied, whether or not VideoButton is displayed. It is removed when access is granted. The button shows its warning content until access is granted or a later camera action replaces the warning.
notifications.startFailed: If starting video fails, shows an error notice such as 'Camera access was denied. Check your browser and system permissions, then try again.', 'Your camera is being used by another application.', 'The selected camera is unavailable. Choose another camera and try again.', or 'No camera was detected.'
